name: Job Ndugai Central Market
subtitle: A large purpose-built market in Nzuguni Ward on the outskirts of Dodoma.

facts.label: Older markets
facts.value: Majengo, Machinga and Sabasaba markets had become overcrowded

facts.label: Majengo Market
facts.value: Described as renowned; a modernisation project was ordered in 2025

parts.text: A large purpose-built market in Nzuguni Ward on the outskirts of Dodoma. It began operating in early 2020 to relieve older, overcrowded markets such as Majengo.
